kind.sameRecording: Same track twice in your Library

switch.keepsEntry: rekordbox keeps this track and its cues. It will show the file as missing until you relocate it in rekordbox.
switch.newTrack: rekordbox will see a new track, without the cues of the old one. The old track will be listed under Tracks to remove in rekordbox. To keep the cues, relocate the file in rekordbox instead.
switch.otherEntry: rekordbox already has this file as another track, and your Library track will become that one, with its cues. The old track will be listed under Tracks to remove in rekordbox. To keep the old cues, relocate the file in rekordbox instead.

reason.notOnDisk: on disk (the other file is gone)
reason.higherCutoffMeasured: measured {{bestKhz}} kHz cutoff (the other isn't measured)

relink.filenameOnly: same file name, no other file has it
relink.uniqueDuration: only file of this length nearby
relink.user: confirmed before, the audio has changed

doubt.sameAudio: the same audio, found in full in both
doubt.versionVeto: the same audio, but the names give different cuts
doubt.sameAudioNamesDisagree: the same audio, but the names disagree
doubt.audioInsideOther: the audio of one file sits inside the other
doubt.audioInsideOtherNamesDisagree: the audio of one file sits inside the other, but the names disagree
doubt.sameTagsPartialAudio: the same names, but only part of the audio is shared
doubt.partialAudioNamesUnclear: part of the audio is shared, and the names don't say what the files are
doubt.mashupContains: a mashup that contains the other file
doubt.labelWordsDiffer: the same audio, but the names carry different version words
doubt.fingerprintVeto: the same names, but the audio shares nothing
doubt.noFingerprint: the same names, and a file has no fingerprint yet
doubt.notCompared: the same names, and the audio was never compared
doubt.sameTitleDifferentArtists: the same title by different artists
doubt.mashupPart: one name looks like a mashup part of the other
doubt.namesUnclear: the names don't say what the files are

error.noAudioKnown: Can't remember this yet: the file is still being scanned
error.switchLinkedOnDisk: Can't switch: the linked file is on disk again
error.switchNotInTrack: Can't switch: that file is no longer a file of this track
error.switchTargetGone: Can't switch: the copy is gone too
error.switchTargetLinked: Can't switch: another Library track uses that file
error.switchEntryTaken: Can't switch: rekordbox's track for that file belongs to another Library track
error.switchChanged: This changed while you were looking at it. Read it again before you switch.
